QuestInfo.name: Asking After Rina, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to check on #b#p201##k, a resident of the town. Let's go see how #p201# is doing.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p201#, a resident of #m10001000#. I'm glad to see she's doing well!

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p201#, one of #m10001000#'s residents, is doing lately. It would be wonderful if you could check on her for me.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Oh, aren't you #h0#? It's so lovely to see you again. What brings you by today?
1.1: Ah, so #p229# asked you to check on me. How sweet... I truly believe no one looks after the people of this town as well as #p229# does.
1.2: As you can see, I'm doing just fine. Except for the fact that I haven't decided on tonight's dinner menu yet, that is. I hope you have a wonderful day too, #h0#!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
